name: Blink Dash (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja has learned to dash between the blinks of her foe’s eyes. Whenever the ninja focuses purely on movement, her form becomes hazy and indistinct. If the ninja takes a run or withdraw action, she is treated as being under the effect of a blur spell until the beginning of her next turn. The ninja must have at least 1 ki point to use this trick.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
